name: Spring / test
idea: In a trading range, after a shake under the range bottom that closed back inside (a spring), a signal on its quiet test that holds over the shake's low. The mirror: the test of an upthrust over the top. Wrong beyond the shake's extreme.

params.label: Bars for the average
params.help: Each bar's spread and volume are measured against the average of this many bars before it. Reference: 20.

params.label: Narrow spread below
params.help: A spread below this multiple of the average range is narrow (a quiet test bar). Reference: 0.7.

params.label: Wide spread above
params.help: A spread above this multiple of the average range is wide. Reference: 1.3.

params.label: Ultra-wide spread above
params.help: A spread above this multiple of the average range is ultra-wide (the climax). Reference: 2.

params.label: High volume above
params.help: Volume above this multiple of the average is high. Reference: 1.3.

params.label: Ultra-high volume above
params.help: Volume above this multiple of the average is ultra-high (the climax). Reference: 2.

params.label: Close position part
params.help: The close is in the low third below this share of the bar's range and in the high third above one minus it. Reference: 0.333333.

params.label: Bars for lower volume
params.help: Lower volume means lower than each of this many bars before. Reference: 2.

params.label: Bars for new highs or lows
params.help: Highs or lows beyond this many bars before are new ground. Reference: 20.

params.label: Bars for the move before
params.help: The move a climax ends: these bars against as many before them. Reference: 10.

params.label: Bars searched for a high-volume area
params.help: A test bar reaches the range of a high-volume bar within this many bars before. Reference: 20.

params.label: Nearness to that area
params.help: How near that bar's range a test bar's low must come, in average ranges. Reference: 0.25.

params.label: Climax only after its move
params.help: Count a climax only after the fall or rise it ends.

params.label: Bars on each side of a swing
params.help: A swing needs this many bars on each side; it is known this many bars after its own bar. Reference: 3.

params.label: Swing size
params.help: A new swing must be this many reference ranges from the last one. Reference: 1.5.

params.label: Bars for Phase A steps
params.help: The automatic reaction, then the secondary test, must each come within this many bars. Reference: 40.

params.label: Secondary test beyond the climax
params.help: How far past the climax the secondary test may go, as a share of the range height. Reference: 0.1.

params.label: Phase B length against Phase A
params.help: A poke beyond an edge counts as a shake only once Phase B has lasted this many times Phase A. Reference: 1.

params.label: Bars to come back
params.help: Back inside within this many bars: a test or a shake; this many closes beyond in a row: a break. Reference: 3.

params.label: Bars to the shake's test
params.help: The quiet test must come within this many bars of the shake. Reference: 20.

params.label: Test near the shaken edge
params.help: The test stays within this share of the range height from the shaken edge. Reference: 0.5.

params.label: Larger structure
params.help: Off: no filter. Not against: no signal against the larger timeframe's lean (a range left the other way, or the opposite trend); a lean of neither way passes. With: only with the larger timeframe's lean (no signal while it leans neither way).

params.label: Larger timeframe
params.help: The higher timeframe whose lean is read (closed bars only).

constraints.message: The narrow limit must be below the wide one.
The wide limit must be below the ultra-wide one.
The high-volume limit must be below the ultra-high one.
The bars for lower volume must be at most the bars for the average.
The larger timeframe must be higher than the signal timeframe.
